title: EFQM: Leaders for Excellence (L4E)
overview: What does excellence mean? What are the fundamental principles organizations need to embrace to achieve excellence? Are there clear criteria that organizations can follow to evaluate their progress? How can organizations ensure continuous improvement in all aspects of their operations? The EFQM Model was developed to address these questions.

This course offers a comprehensive exploration of the EFQM Excellence Model and its three core components. Participants will reflect on, review, and practice each component through a group learning environment. By the end of the course, participants will be equipped to evaluate their organization’s excellence level and identify areas for strategic enhancement.
audience: This course is ideal for professionals, leaders, supervisors, and anyone involved in driving excellence, quality management, and performance improvement. It is especially beneficial for individuals leading or supporting organizational efforts to achieve distinguished national or international quality awards based on the EFQM Model.
methodology: The course integrates a real-life case study provided by EFQM to facilitate practical understanding of the topics covered. It also introduces participants to the Business Excellence Matrix (BEM), an Excel-based assessment tool, to help them apply the model effectively within their organizations.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Use self-assessment as a tool for organizational improvement.
Develop an actionable roadmap for their organization's improvement journey.
Prioritize improvement actions for optimal resource allocation.
Create engagement plans to drive improvement efforts across the organization.
Apply tools and techniques to enhance performance and results.
Understand EFQM’s levels of excellence and align organizational aspirations.
Address cultural aspects of excellence to build on intangible strengths.
